A singleton may match an interior or endpoint color, so align by its sequence offset, not always the first color.

Demo 1: template `[2,3,5,1,6,4]`; isolated 2 at row 2 col 7 produced the full sequence beginning there; 1 at row 5 col 2 produced `[3,5,1,6,4]` with its 1 at col 2 (left clipped); 4 at row 7 col 11 produced sequence ending at col 11 (right alignment from the anchor); palette row unchanged.
Demo 2: `[1,2,4,3]` and `[5,7,8,6]` templates; isolated color 2 at (1,2), 8 at (2,11), 1 at (5,4), 6 at (8,2), and 4 at (8,8) yielded aligned copies. Test palette row 16: `[2,1,3,8]` at columns 0–3 and `[4,5,6,7]` at columns 14–17. For each singleton (row,col,color), match its palette sequence and index, then paint the entire row segment with that translated sequence, clipped to 0..17:
